rows.text: Overwhelmed with excitement, Ishida is in the final round of the Cosmic Horror Film Marathon Championship. All he needs to do is to finish watching this old, sealed videotape, then he'll win the championship title and ten million credits. Blood, severed limbs, and phantoms — These terrifying images are laughable to him, a veteran of horror films. However, his laughter freezes. The scene before him makes his adrenaline surge, his muscles shudder, and he screams for help. By the time the organizers arrive, Ishida has vanished, replaced by a starving swarm of insects.
